findings.frozenDecision: 许继电气 High-priority selection over 思源电气/伊戈尔
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: The inferred H2 catch-up bridge did not materialize by Q3: 许继 Q3 profit was roughly flat YoY while 思源 Q3 profit remained ~49% YoY growth.
findings.generalLesson: Low expectations, lower valuation, contract liabilities and cash receipts are not sufficient evidence of upward revision headroom. A High-priority catch-up thesis needs a measurable conversion bridge from backlog/order/price to near-term revenue or margin.

findings.frozenDecision: 兆易创新 Research selection over 北京君正/江波龙/德明利
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: 江波龙 Q3 single-quarter profit surged as the storage cycle turned; 德明利 also returned to quarterly profit despite still-negative YTD earnings/cash flow.
findings.generalLesson: For cyclical turning points, current earnings quality can be a lagging state variable. Evaluate operating leverage/convexity explicitly while retaining a separate liquidity/solvency downside floor.

findings.frozenDecision: 顺络电子 High-priority selection over 三环集团/风华高科
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: The 60d pre-registered base horizon succeeded versus both controls. By 120d controls later outperformed, which is a dynamic re-ranking/horizon issue rather than evidence that the original 60d selection was invalid.
findings.generalLesson: Do not use later-horizon control reversal to overwrite a correct pre-registered base-horizon decision. Add periodic re-underwriting separately.
